import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb

# Configuration paths
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"

# Load datasets
df_train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
df_test = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

# Select features based on naming convention
feature_cols = [
    c for c in df_train.columns if c.startswith(("margin", "shape", "texture"))
]
X = df_train[feature_cols].values
y_str = df_train["species"].values
test_X = df_test[feature_cols].values

# Encode targets
le = LabelEncoder()
y = le.fit_transform(y_str)
classes = le.classes_

# Ensure column alignment with submission template
target_cols = sample_sub.columns[1:]
class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}

# LightGBM parameters tuned for tabular multi-class classification
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(classes),
    "verbose": -1,
    "force_col_wise": True,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_child_samples": 10,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Cross-Validation for Out-of-Sample Validation
oof_probs = np.zeros((len(X), len(classes)))
fold_losses = []
models = []
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_tr, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=dtrain)

    cb = [lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False)]
    model = lgb.train(
        params, dtrain, valid_sets=[dval], callbacks=cb, num_boost_round=1500
    )
    models.append(model)

    probs = model.predict(X_val)
    oof_probs[val_idx] = probs

    # Official Multi-Class Log-Loss Calculation
    eps = 1e-15
    p = np.clip(probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    p /= p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)  # Row-wise rescaling per spec
    y_onehot = np.zeros_like(probs)
    y_onehot[np.arange(len(y_val)), y_val] = 1
    fold_loss = -np.mean(np.sum(y_onehot * np.log(p), axis=1))
    fold_losses.append(fold_loss)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} LogLoss: {fold_loss:.5f}")

mean_cv_loss = np.mean(fold_losses)
print(f"Average Hold-Out CV LogLoss: {mean_cv_loss:.5f}")

# Generate test predictions by averaging fold models for stability
test_probs = np.mean([m.predict(test_X) for m in models], axis=0)

# Reorder predictions to match submission template exactly
ordered_test_probs = np.zeros((test_probs.shape[0], len(target_cols)))
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    if col in class_to_idx:
        ordered_test_probs[:, i] = test_probs[:, class_to_idx[col]]

# Build and save submission DataFrame
pred_df = pd.DataFrame(ordered_test_probs, columns=target_cols)
pred_df.insert(0, "id", df_test["id"])

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
pred_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission successfully saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
